title: Library instance configuration
description: Configuration for one institutional-archive instance. The engine reads this and holds no knowledge of any specific organisation.

id_prefix.description: Prefix for every document ID in this instance, e.g. 'TL' for Torus Library. A third-party instance sets its own.

type_codes.description: Map of three-letter document type code to human label.

audiences.description: Every audience this instance recognises. Order is not significance.

public_audience.description: The single audience value treated as publicly releasable. If omitted, NO audience is publishable and every public export fails closed.

diligence_categories.description: Instance diligence taxonomy. Omitted means the engine default is used.

binary.description: Absolute path to a Chrome/Chromium binary. If omitted the engine searches standard locations and the CHROMIUM_BINARY environment variable.
